messages:
Marta Vega: Quick sync — after last week's launch, we need to lock scope for the next 2 sprints. proposing: 25% capacity to critical bugs, 40% to high-impact customer asks, 35% to platform/enhancements. Thoughts?
Eli Chen: Can we see numbers? how many P1/P2 bugs today?
Marta Vega: 8 P1-ish (crashes/streaming regressions), ~22 P2 (minor UI/consistency). Metrics: crash rate up 0.6% on prod peak.
Priya Nair: Important to separate "customer asks" into revenue-impact vs quality-of-life. Suggest we reserve 2 customer-ask slots per sprint for escrow customers.
Lucas Romero: Eng capacity for next 2 sprints is ~480 dev hours (3 squads). With 25% for bugs that's 120h — roughly 1.5 full devs.
Samir Patel: From infra: two of the bugs are DB index hot spots; we can prototype a fix in ~2 days, but rollout needs canary + rollback plan.
Marta Vega: ok — propose new split: bugs 30%, customers 30%, enhancements 40% (since platform debt slows future dev). Anyone object?
Eli Chen: +1 but need acceptance criteria for "customer ask" before sloting. maybe 3 items: 1) customer impact quantifiable, 2) test plan, 3) owner.
Priya Nair: Agreed. Also add "rollback checklist" for infra touching tickets.
Lucas Romero: For backlog grooming, I propose weekly 30m triage where PMs tag P1/P2, and engineering gives T-shirt sizes.
Marta Vega: scheduling weekly at Wed 10a. I'll send invites.
Samir Patel: For the DB index fix, I'll add a canary plan: simple migration with feature-flag controlled rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
Marta Vega: Great. Can we capture prioritized list? I'll create a PRD-lite doc with top 6 items and owners.
Eli Chen: Also request a measurement/guardrail: latency p95 and error rate not regressing post-rollout.
Priya Nair: For customer asks, suggestion: 1 sprint hard cut for revenue-impact items (<8w BAU), otherwise queue.
Lucas Romero: One more: swap some enhancement slots to "fast wins" (<=2d) to keep momentum.
Marta Vega: Sounds good. Next actions: Marta -> PRD-lite + invites (today), Lucas -> capacity spreadsheet (EOD), Samir -> canary plan doc (tomorrow), Priya -> customer ask acceptance template (tomorrow), Eli -> metric guardrails (tomorrow).
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 03/15 02:00-03:00 UTC for canary.
Marta Vega: We'll review at Wed 10a triage. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
